S.FORM: alang Wakaba ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Maka go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 331 buwan, 1,267 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 96% kyan ku 1,215 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 4% kyan ku 52 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 93%, Amis 1%, Bunun 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkraya' na Wakaba hya' ga Masilid. tay mkyahu' na Wakaba hya' ga Kazangiljan. tay 'llaw na Wakaba hya' ga Paljur. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ wakaβa ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu maka ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan **** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku **** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** ami[s|ɕ] * βunun * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkrajaʔ na wakaβa ħjaʔ ɣa ma[s|ɕ]ili* taj mkjaħuʔ na wakaβa ħjaʔ ɣa kazaŋiljan taj ʔllaw na wakaβa ħjaʔ ɣa paljur reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
